recommended_uniforms.iAudioBass: Low-frequency energy (31-125 Hz). Drives large-scale motion, scale, dilation, pulse depth. Range 0-2.
recommended_uniforms.iAudioMids: Mid-frequency energy (125-2000 Hz). Drives turbulence, complexity, texture, color shifts, mid-detail. Range 0-2.
recommended_uniforms.iAudioTreble: High-frequency energy (2000+ Hz). Drives sparkle, shimmer, edge highlights, fine detail, micro-motion. Range 0-2.
recommended_uniforms.iAudioEnergy: Overall RMS-like level. Drives global brightness, glow, amplitude. Range 0-1.
recommended_uniforms.iBeatPulse: Onset/transient detection. Sharp pulse on kick/snare. Range 0-1.
